# Vendored DSP sources

- `signalsmith-stretch/signalsmith-stretch.h` comes from Signalsmith Stretch commit `88061fd4eda56a2353c5d65c74aa3f4ccf76f9da`.
- `signalsmith-linear` headers come from Signalsmith Linear tag `0.6.6`, commit `7bb1c8f36794d6980080ce817c91f8da8fe56a66`.
- Both projects use the MIT License. The original notices are in this directory and are also packaged in the APK under `assets/third_party_licenses/`.
- Upstream source: https://github.com/Signalsmith-Audio/signalsmith-stretch and https://github.com/Signalsmith-Audio/linear.
